## Changes

## Validation

- [ ] Run repository hygiene and the relevant synthetic tests.
- [ ] No original game content, private saves, credentials, or generated build/campaign outputs are included.
- [ ] New/changed data has exact-byte provenance review; original executable bytes and game prose stay private even inside source files.
- [ ] Any copied/adapted upstream implementation identifies its revision, affected files, license and required notices.
- [ ] Gameplay, parity, and performance claims identify their actual tested scope; unit passes are not human-playability evidence.
